title: SupportLtRegistrationAttempts
description: Server-only rate-limit state. supportLtRegistrationAttempts/{uid} counts one account's failed code checks: ten within a ten-minute window block that account for ten minutes; successful registration or Auth account deletion removes the document. supportLtSettings/attempts uses the same shape for failures across all accounts: 200 within a ten-minute window block the code for ten minutes, and rotating the code removes the document.
